create_nmf_model: create a Non-negative Matrix Factorization model to decompose data into W and H matrices
fit_nmf_transform_data: fit an NMF model on data and return the transformed low-dimensional representation
create_minibatch_nmf_model: create a MiniBatch NMF model for out-of-core factorization of large datasets
run_non_negative_factorization: run non-negative matrix factorization on a data matrix using coordinate descent solver
transform_data_with_nmf: transform new data using a fitted NMF model to get low-dimensional components
